comment: Which index sources count as published literature, and which do not. Derived provenance is only as honest as this list: the isomorphism index also carries our own deep-search output, and a match against that says the code was found here, not that it was published. A source absent from this file is treated as not-literature, so adding an index source without classifying it can never silently promote a board entry to 'literature'. A source under parameters_only is published but carries no matrices, so a hit there means the parameters are known and equivalence is undecided, never that the code is new.

not_literature.deep_search_2026-09: this project's own deep search, indexed to catch internal duplicates
not_literature.deep_search_unclaimed_2026-09: this project's own deep search, unclaimed candidates
not_literature.board: another entry on this board; a duplicate, not a provenance signal

parameters_only.codetables: https://codetables.de -- bounds only, no construction to compare
